responsibility: Provides the common GCC target configuration for RTEMS-based systems. It defines startup and endfile specs that distinguish the dummy crt0 used for autoconf-style links from normal RTEMS startup objects selected by -qrtems, supplies RTEMS-specific library grouping and linkcmds handling, enables POSIX I/O, adjusts stdint long-versus-int preference for int32_t generation, and defaults TLS code generation to the local-exec model. This header is the core OS-level compile and link policy shared across RTEMS targets.
same_name_distinction: This is the RTEMS policy header that actually defines startfile, endfile, library, stdint, POSIX-I/O, and TLS-model behavior; its same-stem companion gcc/config/rtems.opt only declares the qrtems/qnolinkcmds option metadata and the ignored pthread entry.
